# Strip

> Remove EXIF, GPS, camera and software metadata from JPG, PNG and WebP in the browser.

The public origin is https://strip-local.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Strip metadata](https://strip-local.vercel.app/) — Inspect then remove EXIF/GPS in this tab.

## Guides

* [How to strip](https://strip-local.vercel.app/how-to) — Drop, Fast vs Deep, verify GPS is gone.
* [iPhone](https://strip-local.vercel.app/iphone) — Album / iCloud stay dirty. Files holds the strip.
* [WhatsApp](https://strip-local.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Chat bubble ≠ disk file ≠ send as document.
* [Marketplace](https://strip-local.vercel.app/marketplace) — Listing CDN ≠ the file on disk.
* [What GPS leaks](https://strip-local.vercel.app/exif-gps) — Inspect tags. This URL does not wipe.
* [Why local](https://strip-local.vercel.app/why-local) — Why a server strip is the wrong bargain.
* [Use cases](https://strip-local.vercel.app/use-cases) — Before you post.
* [FAQ](https://strip-local.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy and limits.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API, no HEIC decoder, and no `/blogs/` cluster.
